what: Hovering the banner plate grows an accent-color border from the edge inward, 0 → 7px in .2s ease, framing the plate thickly (plate size and position unchanged, overlaid on the image). On release it shrinks over the same duration. Disabled on devices without hover

options.--fx-z: Stacking order, default 5 — raise it if the artwork inside the panel should sit higher

note: The original appends an empty div.hover to each .hoverable and animates border 0→7px with a transition. The part makes the same shape with a single ::after

from.where: index.html four banners .pk-senkyo · .pk-game · .pk-zukan · .pk-report (original #wrapper .hoverable .hover — border 0 → 7px solid #ffe300, transition all .2s ease)
